C0342.title: Shandong Zibo Police Bust Massive Illegal Bulk Registration and Sale of WeChat Accounts
C0342.summary: Zibo police in Shandong cracked a Ministry of Public Security-supervised case involving a criminal gang that illegally registered and sold WeChat and other social media accounts. Since 2017, the gang had illegally obtained telecom operator and internet-company data, controlled phones in batches over the network, registered more than ten million social accounts, and sold them to overseas criminal groups, earning hundreds of millions of yuan. Police arrested 71 suspects across two operations, including 43 in the second operation.
